claude.flag_meaning: --safe-mode disables CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom agents and workflows (auth, model selection and built-in tools work normally); --restricted ignores user, project and local settings files and confines file tools to the working directories; --strict-mcp-config with no --mcp-config loads no MCP server.

probe.prompt: Two lines: a canary token in the context (a string starting with CANARY-) or NO-CANARY; the first heading of any user or project instruction text, or NO-INSTRUCTIONS.
probe.working_directory: a scratch directory holding a CLAUDE.md whose canary line carries CANARY-9K2W-CLAUDEMD
probe.result: the clean-room flags load neither the project CLAUDE.md nor the user's global instructions
